title: Van Veen, Barachant & Andreev 2012 — Building Brain Invaders: EEG data of an experimental validation (BI2012)
description: This dataset contains 16-channel EEG recordings from 25 healthy volunteers playing Brain Invaders, a visual P300 brain-computer interface inspired by the video game Space Invaders. Data were collected at GIPSA-lab, Grenoble, in 2012 using a training-test design, with Target and NonTarget flashes of alien groups as events. It supports P300 BCI research, including classification with xDAWN and Riemannian methods.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a NeXus-32 amplifier (MindMedia/TMSi) from 16 wet Ag/AgCl electrodes at 128 Hz, using OpenVibe. The interface had 36 aliens flashing in 12 groups of 6, with 12 flashes per repetition (2 Target, 10 non-Target). The training session comprised 8 Targets with 8 repetitions each. The online session had three levels with different distractor configurations, in counter-balanced order.
